key_decisions.decision: Retain the fourfold ethical description without claiming sinless perfection.
Leave each son’s day unspecified rather than asserting birthdays.
Preserve precautionary rather than proven guilt; render the blessing euphemism contextually.
Retain the divine-council designation and the accuser’s title rather than assuming a personal name.
Retain the hand and face imagery and contextual curse euphemism.
Preserve the messenger’s attribution of the fire, not a new narrator explanation.
Preserve the puzzling return there and the familiar balanced blessing without forced novelty.
